notes.title: Planned changes in the visual style and atmosphere of Morganica
notes.notes:
We decided that we need to make some locations more creepy, lively and atmospheric, below is a list of proposed changes. All images are current at the time of publication, and do not reflect future changes.

THE LOWER FLOOR OF THE HOSPITAL 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/d156e6e69698c0043bce062273863702619cc459.png[/img]

The light is only from the top floor, through a gap in the ceiling. 

1. Audio-visual effect - dizzy, everything is blurry, auditory hallucinations. Walls and floor with living bodies immured in them. 
2. A certain ghost is rushing (like a blurred figure) around the floor, suddenly appearing for a moment in different places. His movement is accompanied by screams, groans…

NIGHT YARD 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/b1ab19671391bf7d293784b3d4209464be0ea8fc.png[/img]

1. If a gamer looks at one of the windows, a gloomy figure abruptly appears from the darkness of the room, freezes and slowly goes into the darkness. 
2. When a gamer approaches the door in the wall, it closes abruptly and the growling of a feeding monster can be heard behind it. 
3. If a gamer comes close to the wall of the house, one hears a noise from above and a corpse falls from the roof. 
4. A pile of construction debris. A bloody hand is sticking out of it. When gamer comes closer, the hand abruptly disappears into the trash and a dissatisfied growl is heard. 
5. The opening of the garbage chute in the wall. Coming up. Human remains fall out of the garbage chute with a noise. 
6. Balcony jumper (activated when we approach the bar and provided that we look at the balconies). 
7. A group of insiders around a campfire in a barrel. They cannot be approached (blocked by a fallen billboard).

SUBWAY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/1857c775c8112012fa49d9cc92d5e7d3ef2c40be.png[/img]

1. Ceiling beam collapse
2. Hanging and slowly rotating living human remains - clenching and unclenching fingers of severed hands, heads with grimaces of suffering.

THE CORPSE - EATING HALL 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/81cd2aadc3ca1a26a1529d64280ad84ac51155c3.jpg[/img]

1. Human faces with grimaces of suffering in the cracks of the walls, like petrified figures of giants. 

CEMETERY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/13ea9b02a4aefb80e2d7ba30d5f46686526afcae.png[/img]

1. A face with grimaces of suffering in the breach in the wall  (building opposite the cemetery) 
2. Fragments of the worm skeleton encircling buildings.
